detail.longDescription: New post: Muru: a better tenant in a container. Running gunicorn or uvicorn in a container usually means doing a lot by hand. Under muructl serve, Muru checks your worker settings against the container's limits, replaces a worker before the container runs out of memory, answers probes on a port of its own, shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM, and runs with a read-only root as any user. https:// grahamdumpleton.me/posts/2026/ 11/muru-a-better-tenant-in-a-container/ # Python # Muru # Docker
